sn35.230:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya.
sn35.230:1.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave, maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno vyasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
sn35.230:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, chayime baḷisā lokasmiṃ anayāya sattānaṃ, vyābādhāya pāṇinaṃ.
sn35.230:2.3: santi bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.230:2.4: tañce bhikkhu, abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.230:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno vyasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato. santi bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā …pe… santi bhikkhave ghānaviññeyyā gandhā …pe…
sn35.230:2.6: santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe… santi bhikkhave, kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā …pe…
sn35.230:3.1: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.230:3.2: tañce bhikkhu, abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.230:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno vyasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
sn35.230:4.1: santi ca bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.230:4.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu na gilitabaḷiso mārassa, abhedi baḷisaṃ; na anayaṃ āpanno na vyasanaṃ āpanno, na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato. santi bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā …pe… santi bhikkhave ghānaviññeyyā gandhā …pe…
sn35.230:5.2: santi bhikkhave, kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā …pe… santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn35.230:5.3: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu na gilitabaḷiso mārassa, abhedi baḷisaṃ, na anayaṃ āpanno, na vyasanaṃ āpanno, na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimatoti.
